limitationTriage.limitation: The neighbourhood of alpha=2 in Theorem B is not quantified; no pair above the band is certified.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can kernel positivity on the middle time range be interval-certified at, e.g., (1.99, 2)?

limitationTriage.limitation: Classification away from alpha=2 (Conjecture 12.1) and the band <=> modulus-inequality leg of Conjecture 25 remain open.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the double-zero branch continue and remain the CM boundary on (1,2)?
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.
